description: Get a compact JSON snapshot of a Bridge Data sheet. Sheet layout: column A is the Bridge label column (A1='Data Type', A2='Header', A3='Data', A4+ empty); user data lives in columns B onwards (Row 1 Data Types, Row 2 Field Names, Row 3+ values). Use this before deciding what to edit. Column letters/indices returned by this tool are SHEET coordinates: the first user column is 'B' (index 1), never 'A' (index 0).

sample_rows.description: How many leading data rows (after the Data Type / Field Name header rows) to include in `sample`. Defaults to 5.

name: get_data_sheet_preview
